cap: IgM appears first and can linger for months, so it cannot date an infection by itself. IgG appears next and stays, but it binds weakly at first and more tightly as the immune response matures, which is measured as avidity. In the first trimester, high-avidity IgG means the infection began before pregnancy, low-avidity IgG with IgM means a recent primary infection, and IgM alone means repeat IgG in 2 to 3 weeks.
